# Writing Spark idea collection

`curriculum-ideas.js` and `character-ideas.js` are copied unchanged from
[Writing Spark](https://github.com/anandman/writing-spark), revision
`809ab6ee703ef9ef4ee58ee692f89412d7cc8901`.

They provide 969 original situation ideas for 323 words and 433 simplified
characters. Traditional forms are accepted as input aliases; suggested words
use simplified Chinese. These are ideas for a child's own sentences, not
completed example sentences or a complete curriculum.

Mandarin Grove's interface and per-input decks are implemented in `writing.js`.
